points.description: Chooses white as the paint colour for the doghouse.

Describes the effect on the inside of the doghouse: white absorbs less energy from the lamp, so the air inside stays cooler. Uses the data to support this, e.g. white averaged 42 °C after 10 minutes, compared with 53 °C for black (or equivalent comparison showing white gave the lowest temperature). Equivalent wording and reasoning, such as white reflecting more light, earn the marks.
points.partial_credit: Half a mark (0.5) for a correct description of the effect (white keeps the inside cooler) with no use of the experimental results, or for citing the data without explaining the effect on the doghouse.

rubric.notes: Full marks for choosing white and explaining that it absorbs the least energy so the inside stays cooler, supported by the data (white averaged 42 °C versus 53 °C for black). Half marks for an explanation without data, or data without explanation. Any other colour choice, or no supported explanation, earns no marks for that point.
